title: Sand-Seal Surfing
wikitext:
{{Infobox Ability |image= {{Media |Screenshot BotW= File:BotW Sand-Seal Surfing.png |Screenshot TotK= File:TotK Sand-Seal Surfing.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC |req= |uses= |comp= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Sand-Seal Surfing||Series, TotK}} is a recurring ability in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|TotK}}{{Name Ref|BotW}} Sand-Seal Surfing goes unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Overview== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Sand-Seal Surfing involves [[Shield Surfing]] while being tugged through the [[Gerudo Desert]] by a [[Sand Seal]]. To find a Sand Seal to Surf with, [[Link]] has two options. The first is to capture a wild Seal by [[Stealth|sneaking]] up on it, though it will abandon Link when he stops Surfing. The second is to rent one from a [[Sand-Seal Rental Shop]] in [[Gerudo Town]]. These Seals will not leave Link when he stops. After [[Link]] returns the [[Thunder Helm]] to [[Riju]] as part of the [[Main Quest]] "[[Divine Beast Vah Naboris (Quest)|Divine Beast Vah Naboris]]", she suggests that he Sand-Seal Surf to the [[Lookout Post]]. She then takes her own Seal, [[Patricia]], and Surfs there ahead of him. The two of them Sand-Seal Surf while facing [[Divine Beast Vah Naboris|Vah Naboris]], with Riju using the Thunder helm to provide protection while Link shoots [[Bomb Arrow]]s at the [[Divine Beast]]'s feet. The [[Sand-Seal Race]] [[Mini-Game]] involves Sand-Seal Surfing through a set course in the Gerudo Desert. During the [[Shrine Quest]] "[[The Undefeated Champ]]", Link must beat [[Tali]]'s Surfing record of 1:30 in order to access the [[Raqa Zunzo Shrine]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Sand-Seal Surfing operates the same way that it did in {{BotW}}. The [[Sand-Seal Rental Shop]]s also offer a new type of domesticated Sand Seals, [[Sleigh Seal]]s. Throughout the course of the [[Main Quest]] "[[Riju of Gerudo Town]]", [[Riju]] will use [[Patricia]] to Sand-Seal Surf to both the [[Kara Kara Bazaar]] and [[Dragon's Exile]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} During the [[Movie]] "[[Fragments of Memory]]", [[Urbosa]] and [[Riju]] can be seen Sand-Seal Surfing through the [[Gerudo Desert]] with each other. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Link Fighting Molduga.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Link Sand-Seal Surfing while fighting a Molduga ==See Also== {{See Also| * Shield Surfing }} {{Ref| {{Cite|The {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seals}} here were all trained by Frelly. They're faster, and they'll wait for you to return to them. By comparison, the ones outside who haven't been trained will just run off the moment you dismount.|Essa|BotW}} {{Cite|There's only one way to get close to {{Color BotW|Blue|Naboris}}, and that's with the help of a {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seal}}. The {{Color BotW|Red|lookout post}} isn't too far from town, but you should take a {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seal}} there. You can get some practice in that way. I'll be waiting for you with my favorite sand seal, Patricia.|Riju|BotW}} {{Cite|First, we'll use the {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seals}} to get in really close to that thing. I'll take the lead. I'm counting on you to {{Color BotW|Blue|shoot}} at its feet with {{Color BotW|Blue|bomb arrows}}. Naboris draws energy from the ground to keep moving. If you damage the feet, I think you can stop it. Those lightning strikes, though... Getting hit even once could prove fatal. The {{Color BotW|Blue|Thunder Helm}} can repel the lightning strikes, protecting me from harm. But it can also shield a limited area around me... You'll have to stay close if you don't want to be shocked.|Riju|BotW}} {{Cite|You've decided to challenge the sand-seal racing world champion, Tali!

It seems that, if you can beat the race record, the way to a shrine will open up for you.

The champion's current record stands at {{Color BotW|Red|1 minute and 30 seconds}}.

This won't be easy.|Adventure Log|BotW}} {{Cite|Many travelers have set out into the desert only to discover how quickly their feet sink into the dunes. If you're thinking of crossing the vast Gerudo Desert, make it easy on yourself and go {{Color TotK|Red|sand-seal surfing}} instead! What do you say?
